dedupe_keys.name: cahdc climate adjusted hvac design conditions

description: CAHDC is a global station dataset of HVAC climatic design conditions, the design temperatures and humidities defined in chapter 14 of the ASHRAE Handbook of Fundamentals, given for the observed present-day climate and projected to global warming levels of 1.5, 2, 3 and 4 degrees above pre-industrial. It is produced by D. J. Rasmussen of Degree Day, LLC; version 0.1 was recorded on Zenodo on 12 July 2026 and covers 27,542 stations. The observed baseline is kept as the anchor and climate models contribute only change signals, from regional (CORDEX) and global (CMIP6) projections, with a central estimate and 5th and 95th percentile model-spread bands for every value and warming level. Access: the Zenodo record documents the method but its files are restricted; the values are served through the design.degreeday.org website. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0. Caveats: an early version from a single small provider, not an ASHRAE product. Simulation uses are sizing heating and cooling plant for future climates, overheating risk in buildings and critical facilities, and adaptation of design standards. Related records: the Brazil future weather files and EnergyPlus.
name: CAHDC: Climate-Adjusted HVAC Design Conditions
